name: Example: Computing a Double Summation
worked_solution:
First, we write out the inner summation by summing over the index $i\mathbin{:}$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{j=1}^{3}{\sum }_{i=1}^{2}(i+j) & ={\sum }_{j=1}^{3}[{\sum }_{i=1}^{2}(i+j)] \\  & ={\sum }_{j=1}^{3}[(1+j)+(2+j)] \\  & ={\sum }_{j=1}^{3}(3+2j)\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we calculate the sum above by summing over the index $j\mathbin{:}$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{j=1}^{3}(3+2j) & =(3+2\cdot 1)+(3+2\cdot 2)+(3+2\cdot 3) \\  & =5+7+9 \\  & =21\end{aligned}
$$
